poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE MOMENT THE LIGHTS DIM AND THE HEAT BEGINS TO RISE
poetryFrame.rightVertical: A KINDRED SPIRIT IN SHADOWS WE WILL NEVER LEAVE BEHIND
poetryFrame.bottomLine: THIS FIRE YOU BURN IS ALL I EVER NEED
sonnetLines: The heart takes flight on borrowed breath,
A whispered secret in the velvet night.
Where shadows dance with promised death,
And stars ignite a blinding light.
We chase the tremor down the fading edge,
Of hours lost to rhythm and desire.
The pulse beats loud against the cool air,
A fever rising in the deepest core.
Let time dissolve within the glow,
Where passion makes the spirit know.
